title: Spell or pattern
description: A documented spell, ritual, or pattern. In Underleaf, spells are emergent — they are records of casts that have reliably worked, not a fixed list a caster knows. In other campaigns, this may be a traditional spell entry.

intent.description: What this pattern aims to do. Plain language description of the desired effect.

algorithm.description: The shape of the asking — words, gestures, code, image, sequence. Markdown.

domain.description: Which conceptual domain this operates in. E.g. 'identity', 'emotion', 'systems', 'motion', 'knowledge'.

typicalTier.description: What plausibility tier this pattern usually resolves at. The DM's actual ruling depends on the specific request.

compatibleFoci.description: Domains of foci that resonate with this pattern.

history.description: Where this pattern was first observed, who has used it, what happened. Markdown.
